tables.name: entries
tables.label: Entries
tables.description: The universal node for this trip — the trip itself (kind=trip, one root row), a member (kind=member), a dated SCHEDULE item, or a RESEARCH item (note/link/candidate place). One table so multiuser SHARING actually works: the share pipeline only syncs tables literally named `entries`/`relations`/`users` (custom table names are silently dropped on invite) — pattern copied from tripboard, see MIGRATION.md.

tables.name: relations
tables.label: Relations
tables.description: The edges of the graph, mirroring tripboard/Dispatch exactly: each row links two entries {fromId, toId, type}. type `contains` is the structural trip-root -> item edge the share pipeline's subtree walk follows; there are no other edge types in v1.
